body.text: Coins named for Anthropic's planned stock listing. Anthropic (ANT, Pump.fun): "$ANT The Meme Stock for the Anthropic IPO". Anthropic (ANT, StonkFun): "The Anthropic Ant." Anthropic (ANTS, Pump.fun): "As Anthropic eyes Wall Street, Ant Group dons a suit." Three more coins named Anthropic (Clanker V4: one on Base, 0x191d77..., and two on Robinhood Chain, 0xf289e2... and 0x11188a...) have no description; their name is the story. Posts of 2026-10-26 from Cointelegraph, The Kobeissi Letter and Wall Street Engine report that Anthropic filed an S-1 seeking a Nasdaq listing under the ticker ANT, and later posts report an amended S-1 and an IPO website. Dates from Codex: the ANT pool on StonkFun opened 2026-09-11, the ANT pool on Pump.fun 2026-10-19 and the ANTS pool on Pump.fun 2026-10-31 (after the filing); the Robinhood Chain pool 0xf289e2... opened on 2026-11-04, the Base pool 0x191d77... on 2026-11-05 at 13:59 UTC and the Robinhood Chain pool 0x11188a... on 2026-11-05 at 14:35 UTC, all after it. The descriptions are the coins' own; none of the coins is shown to be connected to Anthropic. Archived (under $1,000 of volume two days running): the Robinhood Chain coin 0xcee339..., the Base coin 0xfff156... and the first Base coin (0xf7b9cf...).

Most recent observation of the story (Nov 9, 2026): Posts of 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-08 say Anthropic made its S-1 public on 2026-10-26 and intends to list on Nasdaq under ANT. Posts of 2026-11-06 and 2026-11-08 say investors are cutting the valuation target from about $1.5-2 trillion to $1.1-1.3 trillion (one post cites the WSJ, another Bloomberg of 2026-11-06); a post of 2026-11-07 says Polymarket odds of an IPO jumped to about 88% in a day. Reports in posts, not verified here. A name-only Anthropic coin on Base (Clanker V4, 0x0a3467..., pool opened 2026-11-08 13:42 UTC) traded $22.3M in 24h at a $10.2M market cap. A Claude coin on Robinhood Chain (0xb19cae..., opened 2026-11-09 04:06 UTC) shows almost the same market cap ($10,201,767 against $10,201,770) and volume ($22.2M); its name does not refer to the IPO and it is not a member. The older Base Anthropic coin 0xf6d41c... was archived (under $1,000 on two observations); 0xff20a7... fell from $24.1M to $181 of token volume in a day and is one observation under the threshold. None of the coins is shown to be connected to Anthropic.
